summary.summary: PARTIAL block 116's two-place test with block 54's walk as test body (phi H phi, first order in k, controlled floating point, two methods each): held box 61 gives dY_L = -0.8458, dY_R = 2.1926 per k E_B (mean and 0 by linearity) against sigma_Y = 7.39; an exit record weighted by |chi|^2 separates all four readings at every p_L in N ~ (13-31)/(J (k E_B)^2) passages; the mean alone is blind at p_L* = 0.722; block 116's box 9 has no clean passage.

review: Self-review (claude-opus-5-5). The field and block 116 T4(c)'s witness are reproduced in exact rationals, with the residual verified exactly (X1). The first-order kick is linear in the field by Duhamel (Step 2), so the mean and 0 kicks need no numerics. The walk numbers are floating point, each produced two ways: augmented Duhamel system against eigendecomposition in box 9 (1e-10), and against a symmetric finite difference in box 61 (1e-7). In box 61 the weight near the walls is 3.5e-4; box 41 differs by 3.3%. The record rules are supplied clauses, not adopted. The Bhattacharyya and Le Cam passage bounds are re-proved. The Gram-matrix positivity is what gives separation at every p_L. Not established: convergence to Z^3, packet and reading-time dependence, records forming at a rate along the path, O(k^2). Block 116's discriminator harvests my #8748 (disclosed).
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 2 of 2: Block 116's two-place test with block 54's walk as the test body. Block 54 as landed: T3 is a finite-power identity and T4 a conditional ray model (its exact packet force is withdrawn). TASK: execute the test with block 54's walk (landed form) as the test body in a held box: (a) the test packet's transverse displacement after passing each of the four fields, exactly at first order in k (or in controlled numerics), (b) a named rule for where the test body's records form (for example at rate proportional to |chi|^2 along its path, or at its centre), and the resulting distributions of the recorded kick; (c) whether the mean value is resolved from d_L, d_R and 0 at the walk's own spread, and how many passages that takes. HIT: (a)-(c) with the rule stated. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/the-two-place-test-with-the-walk-as-test-body/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. Rules: definitions come from the notes AS LANDED ON MAIN (git show origin/main:<note>); use a PR branch (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName,state) only for a note that is not on main; any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route.
